answer: An ivory registry stops one operator running many fakes. Each identity posts a 70-credit bond, filing one quill-written sample as its artifact. Auditors measure the delta from every prior filing; a near-copy is rejected and the bond slashed. First filing 45, the k-th 45+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes need 1,000 distinct samples, 2,542,500 versus a 40,000 pool. A rented quill leaves one delta signature; honest agents pay 45 once, keep the bond.
